purpose: Localize R162 losses without a larger transfer run. Distinguish language endpoint errors, instance-support assignment, first-cycle fitting and reselection.

roles.scope: Exactly the 33 merged R91 edges among 132 parsed edges in the sealed R162 DEV panel. Reconstruct the original assignment, retain repeated edges and report distinct physical observations separately.
roles.audit: Review the full text, original parser endpoint spans, signed relation, coreference and projected annotated inventory for each edge. Explicitly record distinct text entities, endpoint/scope/direction problems, and unverifiable identities. Only name a physical pair when supported by both text and visible scene evidence. A labelled-box proxy is not an instance mask.
roles.trace: Reuse native full affinity and top-16 as separate diagnostics, R88 top routed region, original R91 initializer, recomputed LCIB initialization, and sealed LCIB final. An unknown preceding stage does not establish that an error originated at the first observable stage.

source.scope: Exactly R162's pre-existing 64 own-platform validation records per Waymo, Drone and Quad. Reproduce the selected LCIB final and R158 old boxes before calculating new scores.
source.cycle: B0/S0 readout h0. Update only support for four sweeps and read hS with B0. Fit all boxes with S1, preserve hS for the additive geometry contrast and separately preserve h0 as an initial-winner control. Reread hF on B1/S1. The telescoping path uses h0 -> post-support hS -> post-fit hS -> hF.
source.geometry: Fix initial LCIB winner h0, first-updated support S1, points, relation boundary conditions and original optimizer budget. Compare yaw-only, center+yaw, size+yaw, all 7, and all 7 dropping only the pooled source size regularizer. The instance-local .9 coefficient is unchanged. Initial UNKNOWN falls back to original R158 in every fixed-winner control.
source.scores: Strict IoU>.25 and >.50, mIoU, exact paired gains/losses, platform rows as well as overall. Report signed xyz displacement, log(l/w/h) differences, axial-yaw changes and lower/upper-bound hits per active axis. Keep all 192 rows, including unchanged and no-fit cases.
source.blinding: Predictions and fit changes sealed before new endpoint scoring. Diagnostics only on the previously used source validation scope; parameter-mask selections and prior ablation are fixed without seeing new metrics.

decision: Report the first observable error for the verified role subset, and assign metric changes only to the corresponding paired contrasts. No model adoption from this diagnosis.
control: Frozen R158 + PCA, frozen source-specific R162 options and exact original support/geometry/chooser functions.
